title: An explicit extra degeneracy for bars of partial sums
statement: Let C be a category with countable coproducts and coproducts in a universe u. Given F:Nat→C and r∈Nat, let D(n) be the coproduct of F(k) over k<n+r+1, indexed by the natural-number preorder lifted to universe u. The augmented simplicial bar [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] from D to the countable coproduct of F has an explicit extra degeneracy.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: On the summand F(k) of a string beginning at n, prepend the first stage k-r containing it, using truncated natural subtraction. Since k<n+r+1, k-r≤n, and since k<k-r+r+1, the same summand exists there. The augmentation section includes F(k) at the constant zero-simplex k-r. Deleting the new vertex is identity; deleting an old vertex or repeating a vertex commutes with prepending. Deleting the other vertex in degree one gives section after augmentation. Verify these identities on the two levels of coproduct generators. Thus every extra-degeneracy field is proved and all its data is constructed directly.
